dialogue.speaker: Dr. Sultanov
dialogue.text: Good morning, Baurzhan. Please sit down. So — you are finishing your third year next month. How do you feel about your progress?

dialogue.speaker: Baurzhan
dialogue.text: Good morning, Dr. Sultanov. I feel quite positive, actually. My grades this year are much better than last year.

dialogue.speaker: Dr. Sultanov
dialogue.text: Yes — I can see that. Your Economics grade went from 71 to 88. That is excellent improvement. What changed?

dialogue.speaker: Baurzhan
dialogue.text: I started studying more systematically. I review my notes every evening, and I joined the Economics Research Group in January.

dialogue.speaker: Dr. Sultanov
dialogue.text: Good. Now — what are your plans for the summer break?

dialogue.speaker: Baurzhan
dialogue.text: I'm going to do an internship at a business consulting firm in Almaty for six weeks. I applied in March and got a place.

dialogue.speaker: Dr. Sultanov
dialogue.text: Impressive! Can you speak Kazakh, Russian, and English in a professional context?

dialogue.speaker: Baurzhan
dialogue.text: I can speak Kazakh and Russian fluently. My English is getting better — I can read reports and write emails, but I can't give a full presentation yet.

dialogue.speaker: Dr. Sultanov
dialogue.text: That is honest. English is going to be essential in your career. What are you going to do to improve it?

dialogue.speaker: Baurzhan
dialogue.text: I'm going to attend an intensive English course this autumn. And I'm going to read one English article about business every morning.

dialogue.speaker: Dr. Sultanov
dialogue.text: Excellent. And after you graduate next year — what are your long-term plans?

dialogue.speaker: Baurzhan
dialogue.text: I'm going to work for two or three years first. Then I'm going to apply for a Master's degree in Finance — ideally in Almaty or Astana.

dialogue.speaker: Dr. Sultanov
dialogue.text: A solid plan. One last question — are there any areas of your studies that are still difficult for you?

dialogue.speaker: Baurzhan
dialogue.text: Statistics. I find it the most challenging subject. But I'm not going to give up — I'm going to hire a private tutor next semester.

dialogue.speaker: Dr. Sultanov
dialogue.text: That shows real maturity, Baurzhan. I think you're going to have a very successful career. Good luck with the internship!

dialogue.speaker: Baurzhan
dialogue.text: Thank you very much, Dr. Sultanov. I will work hard and make WKU proud!
